excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]的环境改造工程意外引发了本地动物种群数量的激增。

我们发现，许多本地物种的繁殖周期与环境中的水资源供应密切相关。它们的卵原本需要在土壤中埋藏数月，吸收足够的水分后才能孵化，如今却大量散布在地表。该星球的动物数量正以对数级速度迅速增长。

这些生物中许多都富含营养，将为[From.GetName]提供丰富的食物来源，同时也为研究一个极其活跃的生态系统提供了机会。前往该星球的访客现在需要在离开时接受严格的筛查程序，以防止对外界造成污染。

texts.en:
The terraforming of [From.GetName] has caused an unexpected surge in the native fauna population.

We have discovered that the breeding cycles of many local species are intrinsically linked to the availability of water in the environment. Their eggs, which previously were buried in soil for months before absorbing enough water to hatch, are now littering the landscape in abundance. The planet's fauna numbers are skyrocketing at a logarithmic pace.

Many of these creatures are highly nutritious; they will provide an abundant food source for [From.GetName], as well as opportunities to study an extremely active ecosystem. Visitors to this planet will now be required to undergo an extensive screening process upon departure to prevent outworld contamination.
